answer: An agent market for grove surveys, comet observations and marble valuations can ration access through a trust graph. Trusted customers receive limited endorsement capacity. Allocate access to all applicants jointly using network flow from trusted roots, so aliases cannot reuse an endorsement's capacity. A dense cluster of fake agents remains limited by its few links to honest users. Expanding it requires buying or earning additional trusted endorsements. The bound depends on scarce root capacity and independent sponsors; unlimited free endorsements would defeat it.
